scripts.core: cd core && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w' -o ../src-tauri/binaries/garmin-export-core-$(rustc -vV | awk '/host/{print $2}') ./cmd/garmin-export-core
scripts.core:universal: cd core && for a in arm64:aarch64 amd64:x86_64; do CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=${a%%:*} go build -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w' -o ../src-tauri/binaries/garmin-export-core-${a##*:}-apple-darwin ./cmd/garmin-export-core || exit 1; done && lipo -create -output ../src-tauri/binaries/garmin-export-core-universal-apple-darwin ../src-tauri/binaries/garmin-export-core-aarch64-apple-darwin ../src-tauri/binaries/garmin-export-core-x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.test: node scripts/test-ids.js && bun run test:core && bun test sidecar && bunx playwright test
scripts.test:core: cd core && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.sidecar: cp ../electron-app/renderer/date-range.js ui/ && bun build --compile sidecar/cli.js --outfile src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-$(rustc -vV | awk '/host/{print $2}') && bun run core
scripts.sidecar:universal: cp ../electron-app/renderer/date-range.js ui/ && for a in arm64:aarch64 x64-baseline:x86_64; do bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-${a%%:*} sidecar/cli.js --outfile src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-${a##*:}-apple-darwin || exit 1; done && lipo -create -output src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-universal-apple-darwin src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-aarch64-apple-darwin src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-x86_64-apple-darwin && bun run core:universal
scripts.release: bun run sidecar:universal && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --config '{"build":{"beforeBuildCommand":""}}'
